rightsReview.selection: The 300 smallest candidates with an exact CC0/public-domain assertion, or an allowed attribution licence plus captured creator attribution; every representation is at most 70,000,644 bytes.

limitations: Discovery role hints are source-search provenance, not semantic labels, and this recovery cohort is not balanced across every filler role.
Source date metadata is incomplete; an exact recording year and derived era still require grounded evidence or operator confirmation.
The current corpus and Clip contracts cannot represent country, geographic scope, or local market, so this cohort cannot prove geography-safe sourcing or scheduling.
The development-only Archive policy accepts exact item licence assertions as operational authority and is not a chain-of-title warranty or shipped-media authority.
The recovered media and private ledgers remain outside Git. The cohort has not been prepared, blind-labeled, adjudicated, or locked as a semantic manifest.
The separate 1,126-case holdout and bounded provider and shadow matrices remain incomplete.
